26/27 MMS CLUBS & ACTIVITIES


  

Registration and Payment Info 
CLUB INFO: In order to join a club, students should access that club's Google Classroom, using the advertised classroom codes. The most up to date information regarding club scheduling and cancellations can be found there. All try-outs and auditions are closed to parents/guardians, which respects the privacy of all of our students and allows our coaches to use their discretion when fielding teams and performing arts groups.    
Parents, please use the following QR code/link above to sign up for travel sports ($250) and clubs ($200) for this school year. Sports tryouts and Club announcements will be included in this bulletin, advertised throughout school, and also on our morning announcements.
LATE BUS INFORMATION: Clubs and Sports Practices will end at 3:30 pm. MMS has a holding area from 3:30-4pm where students will be supervised until late buses arrive. 


We encourage parents and guardians to pick up their child at 3:30pm at the APR, which is the end of clubs/practices so they do not have to “wait” for late buses. Just a reminder for those new to late buses, we only have 4 buses, so late buses generally take longer than the normal bus runs. 
We thank you for your understanding and flexibility! 
________________


LOGICA CLUB: Have you ever wanted to play Dungeons and Dragons? Do you like to play board games? Join Logica starting Thursday, October 8th in Mr. Turner's room. No Google Classroom to join, just come stop by if you're interested.  


FUN AND FITNESS CLUB:  If you’re interested in fun activities, fitness challenges, healthy habits, and new friends, sign up using Google Classroom Code: mfj2m3kp.  The first meeting will be Tuesday, October 6th in room 218. 


SAL’S PIZZA DAY: on Wednesday Oct. 14th & Wednesday Oct. 28th Sal’s pizza will be sold as an “extra” during lunch. It will be $2.85 a slice, cash or lunch accounts may be used.


PICKLEBALL: Will meet Thursdays in the GYM. Pickleball will start on October 1st! To sign up use Google Classroom code:  lms2lh7j. You MUST have a physical on file with the Nurse’s office to participate.  October club dates will be the 1st,15th, and 22nd. 


LUNCH IN THE LIBRARY: If you want to enjoy your lunch in a friendly, welcoming space, sign up for the “Lunch in the Library” by the posted deadline using the Google form on the library webpage.  Passes will be given to your homeroom teacher to distribute.


POKEMON CLUB: All fans of Pokemon are welcome to come to battle, trade, chat and learn all things Pokemon! We meet Wednesdays in Room 224, the first meeting is Wednesday October 7th! Sign up using Google Classroom Code: QKMNQC5S


CHECKERS / CHESS CLUB: will be meeting in Room 224 on Tuesday 10/6 & 10/20! Come join the fun! All levels are welcome. Sign up using the Google Classroom code: qxyiynsi 


MMS CHOIR:  will meet every Wednesday after school in Room 321, starting October 7th. Any MMS student is welcome to join! To sign up use Google Classroom Code: p74txcp6 


ATTENTION STUDENTS: PEER TUTORING IS AVAILABLE during your lunch/recess in Room 132. Come with your lunch and chromebook/assignment. We look forward to helping you.


ATTENTION PARENTS/GUARDIANS: Your students should have a working pair of wired earbuds with their school supplies each day. We do not provide them. Thank you for your cooperation.


EARLY DISMISSALS & ABSENCES:  If you are picking up your child for early dismissal or if your child will be absent please contact your child’s house office. When a student leaves early, we will have the student prepared to leave with a pass, and notify their teachers. You may leave a voice message, or email, with the pickup time. House office information can be found below. 
YOU WILL NEED YOUR LICENSE with you in order to sign your child out at the visitor entry system. *Students must check out with the Main Office BEFORE leaving the building!*
